lines.text: *Bang*!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Argh! That really stings, you know?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Emma, confirm the point of impact.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Direct hit to the head.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What the hell is this thing?
Vesti! The clamp!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: On it!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Missile container online.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Firing missiles now.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Eat this!
*Shooosh*
A barrage of missiles launch from Vesti's back.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Would you look at that? So many.
*Poooooow*!
There is a resounding explosion, and Behemoth is enveloped in smoke.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Your aim is as accurate as always.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Hehe.
Counters! Go!
Don't get caught by the clamp!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hyaaaaah!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Let's go!
The Counters rush towards the now thinning smoke.
At this point, we have to do our best to avoid any direct confrontation.
All this swirling smoke is sure to obscure their vision. We have to be quick and get both Grave and the coffin.
*Kagak* *Kagakak*
Rapidly expanding crystals surge along the ground,
letting out an ominous crack as they race towards the Counters.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What the...?!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Argh! I'm hit!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Where are they coming from?!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Impact sites are Rapi's right hand and left arm, both of Neon's legs, and Anis's right thigh.
Shut down power to those areas!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Who the hell is she? How does she have such control over the crystals?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sensing movement up ahead to the left.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Time to destroy this thing!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: If you don't mind, I'm in the middle of having a conversation.
*Kagak* *Kagakak*
What is this...
The crystals expand rapidly and, along with a sinister cracking sound,
surround us.
The razor-sharp crystalline thorns hang ominously in the air,
a threat that they could pierce through us at any moment if we make a wrong move.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I-I guess it'd be a good idea to stay still.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Nobody move. The crystals are too close.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: She's playing with us...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: S-she's coming over here.
The thick smoke begins to dissipate.
Behemoth walks towards us, without casting so much as a glance at Grave, who is still pinned to the ground.
She smiles.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Now now, nobody move, please.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes, you. You're the Commander, are you not?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I only want to hear from you. The rest of you keep quiet.
Everyone, stay calm and do what she says.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Are you trying to apprehend me, or that pathetic piece of waste over there?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You can take her, but the coffin stays with me.
Are you a Heretic?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes.
Are you in charge of this place?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes.
What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I could ask you the same thing.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: This is my land.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: My secret garden,

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: and you're intruding.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It's high time I ask you what you're doing here.
We're interested in Grave and the coffin.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Grave?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Oh, her? A fitting name indeed for her.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: But why the coffin?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do you know what this is?
It contains a Heretic named Anachiro.
Now that I can have a closer look at Behemoth,
I can clearly make out a black liquid which is coursing through her body.
Perhaps that is what gives her such remarkable defensive capabilities.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You knew? Color me surprised.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What do you want with Anachiro?
We want to make her an ally.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Are you being serious?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do you even fully realize what this thing inside the coffin is?
No. To be perfectly honest, we're not entirely sure.
What we do know is that everyone is doing their utmost to get their hands on it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Well, let me fill you in.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She's our predecessor.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: The original fusion. Both our origin, and the genesis of our legend.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Our ancestor.
So you have respect for your elders. How nice of you.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hehe, yes indeed.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We're kind of in the middle of something,

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: and we could really use her help.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's why I'm doing this.
You said "we" could use her help? So, you're not operating alone?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: There are four of us, including myself.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We call ourselves the Four Beasts. Catchy name, don't you think?
Four Heretics...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Unfortunately for me, I'm in a bit of a pickle, since I can't get this coffin open.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: If I'm too rough with it and try to bash it open, it'll kill Anachiro.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: However, you work with all sorts of high-tech gadgets, don't you?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Help us open that thing.
What do we get in return?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Let's see, what could I offer you...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How about some more information on the crystal?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I'm sure you're rather curious about a mysterious entity like this which you haven't seen before.
Something tells me you don't know much about it either.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Don't be stupid. You saw for yourself how I can control them.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We're the ones who created these things.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Partly by chance, sure, but hey, it's working out.
Casting a quick glance around me,
in the midst of the dense gathering of crystals surrounding us,
I notice a slight gap close to me.
This should be...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What do you say? Do we have a deal?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I'm giving you a golden opportunity to do a great thing for humanity, which I know is your thing.
I need some time to think.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Patience is normally not one of my virtues,

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: but since this is a rare opportunity, I'll wait.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: In the meantime, you have something I want.
I relax my body so that I'll be able to dart away at a moment's notice.
I have something you want? We only just met.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes, and as for what it is...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hmm... saying it out loud is a bit awkward.
Behemoth hesitates and turns her back to us.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How should I put this?
Eunhwa! Chest!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What?
Sorry,
I meant disk!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hmm? What are you two yelling abou...
With a flick of her wrist, Eunhwa tosses me a disk.
I catch it and hurl it towards the small opening I see in the crystalline cage.
Mana! Shifty!

lines.speaker: mana_op
lines.text: Three A Pillars headed your way.

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Coming in at maximum speed.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What are you doing?
Everyone! Brace for impact!
*Thud* *Thud* *Thud*

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: A Pillar landing confirmed.

lines.speaker: mana_op
lines.text: Skipping activation for sequence condition check.

lines.speaker: mana_op
lines.text: Proceeding straight to Ark creation sequence.
Structures start to expand,
*Pagagagak*
pushing aside the crystals surrounding us.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What the... what is this?!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Need-to-know basis, and you don't need to know.
Anis charges forward and bends down, tackling Behemoth's legs.
Aim for the abdomen!
Anis's charge causes Behemoth to lose her balance and stumble to the ground. At the same time, Neon rushes in and fires her weapon at Behemoth's stomach.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Fire—power!!
*Bang bang bang bang*!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Argh!
It's working!
Rapi, you're up!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger!
Rapi leaps up and rotates her body to deliver a powerful roundhouse kick.
Just as she's about to make contact...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You've all underestimated me.
Behemoth's clamps surge forth to intercept Rapi.
*Bang*

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What? What's happening? Why can't I move?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You could stand to reinforce your joints a bit, you freak.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Thanks for the advi...
*Crack*!
Rapi delivers a forceful kick to Behemoth's abdomen, which sends her staggering backwards.
Seizing the moment, Vesti takes aim.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You're on track for a direct hit! Take the shot!

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Take this!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Urgh!
*Craaaaaaaaaash*!
Vesti fires a volley of missiles, which slam directly into Behemoth.
A massive explosion rocks the area, sending smoke and debris flying.
Now! Secure the coffin and Grave and then withdraw!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: This feels a bit weird, like we're a bunch of robbers or something.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't say that! Now I feel kinda guilty.

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Securing escape route. Follow my instructions.
Rapi springs over to the coffin and stands before it.
Rapi, we have to secure the coffin! Don't destroy it!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If I force it open, Anachiro will die...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: My treasure...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Please... return it.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... I thought you passed out.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I must...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: return... it.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Please, wait...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: My idol.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: My dream...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Damn it.
Rapi?
Rapi lifts up both the coffin and Grave and rushes forward.
